sentences.quote: President and CEO Christophe Fouquet joined ASML in 2008 and held several management positions in marketing and product management prior to CEO, including Chief Business Officer from 2022 to 2024, EVP of EUV from 2018 to 2022 and EVP of Applications from 2013 to 2018.
sentences.text: Christophe Fouquet is President and CEO of ASML, having joined the company in 2008 and worked his way up through a series of management roles in marketing and product management, including EVP of Applications from 2013 to 2018, EVP of EUV from 2018 to 2022 and Chief Business Officer from 2022 to 2024.

sentences.quote: Prior to ASML, he worked at industry peers KLA Tencor and Applied Materials.
sentences.text: Before ASML, he worked at industry peers KLA Tencor and Applied Materials.

sentences.quote: While CFO Roger Dassen comes from a pure finance and audit background (previously at Deloitte), there are mostly engineers at the top (the CEO has a physics background, and the CTO is a mathematician).
sentences.text: A physicist by training, he fits the broader pattern at the top of ASML, where most senior executives are engineers with decades of accumulated technical knowledge, the notable exception being CFO Roger Dassen, who comes from a finance and audit background at Deloitte.

mgmt_bio.text: Christophe Fouquet is President and CEO of ASML, having joined the company in 2008 and worked his way up through a series of management roles in marketing and product management, including EVP of Applications from 2013 to 2018, EVP of EUV from 2018 to 2022 and Chief Business Officer from 2022 to 2024. Before ASML, he worked at industry peers KLA Tencor and Applied Materials. A physicist by training, he fits the broader pattern at the top of ASML, where most senior executives are engineers with decades of accumulated technical knowledge, the notable exception being CFO Roger Dassen, who comes from a finance and audit background at Deloitte.

sentences.text: At the April 22, 2026 AGM, Marco Pieters was appointed to the Board of Management and Roger Dassen and Frederic Schneider-Maunoury were reappointed; this expanded the board from five to six members, with Pieters having served as CTO since October 2025.
Alexander Everke's Supervisory Board term ended, Benjamin Loh joined, and the terms of Nils Andersen and Jack de Kreij end at the 2027 AGM.
In January 2026 management told staff it would reorganize Technology and IT, possibly cutting about 1,700 net positions, framing the move as made from a position of strength.
